mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lt1h, SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time <= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND t.create_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lt1d, SUM(CASE WHEN t.create_time <= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ge1d FROM `task` t WHERE t.status = 'pending'

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, MIN(l.create_time)) AS minutes FROM `task` t JOIN `task_log` l ON l.task_id = t.id AND l.action = 'dispatch' WHERE l.create_time >= #{from} AND l.create_time < #{to} AND t.create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.id
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), NOW())

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{shiftSeconds}, t.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `task` t WHERE t.create_time IS NOT NULL AND t.create_time >= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{shiftSeconds}, #{from}) AND t.create_time < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{shiftSeconds}, #{to}) GROUP BY day

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' AND t.plan_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTimeBase, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' AND t.plan_end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time <= t.plan_end_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTime, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' AND t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS durationBase, AVG(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' AND t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.actual_start_time, t.actual_end_time) END) AS avgMinutes FROM `task` t WHERE t.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time >= #{from} AND t.actual_end_time < #{to}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.observed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, a.severity AS severity, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `task_alert` a WHERE a.observed_at >= #{from} AND a.observed_at < #{to} GROUP BY day, severity

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN a.severity = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical, SUM(CASE WHEN a.handled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handled, AVG(CASE WHEN a.handled_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.observed_at, a.handled_at) END) AS mttrMinutes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `task_alert` WHERE status IN ('pending', 'handling')) AS openNow FROM `task_alert` a WHERE a.observed_at >= #{from} AND a.observed_at < #{to}
SELECT u.id AS id, u.name AS name FROM `user` u JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.status = '1' AND r.code = 'pilot' ORDER BY u.id

SELECT t.pilot_id AS pilotId, COUNT(*) AS taskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' AND t.plan_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTimeBase, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'finished' AND t.plan_end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time <= t.plan_end_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTime, SUM(r.flight_hours) AS hours, SUM(r.flight_count) AS sorties FROM `task` t LEFT JOIN `task_report` r ON r.task_id = t.id AND r.is_latest = 1 WHERE t.pilot_id IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time >= #{from} AND t.actual_end_time < #{to} GROUP BY t.pilot_id

SELECT t.pilot_id AS pilotId, COUNT(*) AS started, SUM(CASE WHEN t.evidence_state IN ('declared', 'stale') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noProof FROM `task` t WHERE t.pilot_id IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_start_time >= #{from} AND t.actual_start_time < #{to} GROUP BY t.pilot_id

SELECT x.pilotId AS pilotId, SUM(x.offers) AS offers, SUM(x.refused) AS refused FROM ( SELECT t.pilot_id AS pilotId, 1 AS offers, 0 AS refused FROM `task_log` l JOIN `task` t ON t.id = l.task_id WHERE l.action = 'dispatch' AND t.pilot_id IS NOT NULL AND l.create_time >= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{shiftSeconds}, #{from}) AND l.create_time < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{shiftSeconds}, #{to}) UNION ALL SELECT l.operator_id AS pilotId, 1 AS offers, 1 AS refused FROM `task_log` l WHERE l.action = 'refuse' AND l.operator_id IS NOT NULL AND l.create_time >= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{shiftSeconds}, #{from}) AND l.create_time < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{shiftSeconds}, #{to}) ) x GROUP BY x.pilotId
SELECT d.id AS id, d.code AS code, d.name AS name, d.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(d.purchase_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS purchaseDate FROM `drone` d ORDER BY d.code

SELECT t.drone_id AS deviceId, SUM(r.flight_hours) AS hours, SUM(r.flight_count) AS sorties FROM `task` t JOIN `task_report` r ON r.task_id = t.id AND r.is_latest = 1 WHERE t.drone_id IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time >= #{from} AND t.actual_end_time < #{to} GROUP BY t.drone_id

SELECT a.device_code AS deviceCode, COUNT(*) AS alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN a.severity = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS criticalAlerts FROM `task_alert` a WHERE a.device_code IS NOT NULL AND a.observed_at >= #{from} AND a.observed_at < #{to} GROUP BY a.device_code

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(e.observed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, e.device_code AS deviceCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `task_evidence` e WHERE e.valid = 1 AND e.observed_at >= #{from} AND e.observed_at < #{to} GROUP BY day, e.device_code

SELECT t.id AS id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.route_snapshot AS routeSnapshot FROM `task` t WHERE t.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_end_time >= #{from} AND t.actual_end_time < #{to} ORDER BY t.id

SELECT p.id AS id, p.code AS code, p.name AS name FROM `survey_point` p WHERE p.id IN
#{id}
